events.event: China fentanyl tariff raised to 20%; 25% on Canada and Mexico (non-USMCA goods)
China reciprocal tariff raised to 125% (145% with fentanyl tariff); higher country rates for others paused
Geneva truce: China reciprocal tariff cut to 10% (30% with fentanyl tariff)
Additional 25% on India over Russian oil purchases: 50% combined
China fentanyl tariff cut from 20% to 10% after Trump-Xi deal
US-India deal: Russian-oil tariff removed, India rate cut to 18%
Supreme Court rules IEEPA does not authorize tariffs (Learning Resources v. Trump); IEEPA tariffs end
Temporary global import surcharge (10%, reported increase to 15%) for up to 150 days
Section 122 expires; new Section 301 'forced labor' tariffs of 10-12.5% on 60 economies (Section 232 goods excluded)
CBP reports about $122 billion of IEEPA tariff refunds issued via its CAPE system (Phases I-II accepted nearly $135 billion in claims)
